failures.detail: 禮拜 s1 o1: The Collection from the Patriarchs' Hall (祖堂集), Yantou section (巖頭; the episode is told in Yantou's chapter): Xuefeng (雪峰), at Yantou's words, "at these words Feng had a great awakening" (峰於此言下大悟), "thereupon bowed" (便禮拜), and "rose and said in one breath" (起來連聲云), "this is the completing of the Way at Mount E" (便是鵝山成道也). The encounter-dialogue bow as the response to awakening. Narrated case → MasterName null.

禮拜 s1 o2: (景德傳燈錄), the (亮座主) (Preacher Liang) case: he has a sudden awakening and bows (豁然大悟禮拜), and Mazu (祖) says "you dull-root lecturer, what are you bowing for?" (遮鈍根阿師禮拜作麼). The bow challenged, not accepted. The same (禮拜作麼) recurs across the lamp/case records — the (亮座主) case again in X69n1321 (lb 0004c05), C078n1720, J38nB406, and the (無業) case (這鈍漢禮拜作麼) in X68n1319 — multi-source. Two-speaker raised case → MasterName null.

禮拜 s1 o3: (祖堂集), (德山) section; after the master says "ask and you err; don't ask and you also miss" (問則有過，不問則又乖) the monk bows (僧便禮拜) and the master strikes him (師乃打之); the monk protests "I just bowed — why strike?" (某甲始禮，為什摩卻打). Directly links the bow to the blow (便打) and shows the bow met with a hit. Dialogue → MasterName null.

禮拜 s1 o4: (祖堂集), (德山) section; the candle-blowing exchange with Longtan (龍潭) — Longtan blows out the light (lb 0406b08: 龍潭便息卻, "Longtan thereupon put it out"), the master himself bows (師便禮拜), and Longtan asks "what principle did you see?" (見什摩道理). Instance of (師便禮拜) (153×): the master, not only the disciple, performs the bow. The acting (師) is Deshan; dialogue/narrated → MasterName null.

禮拜 s1 o5: (古尊宿語錄); the departure form — the monk "bowed and withdrew" (禮拜而退), the master calls him back "come here, come here" (且來且來). The same exchange recurs in D48n8939 (且來且來) and, punctuated (且來)，(且來), in J23nB134 and J24nB138 — multi-source. Dialogue → MasterName null.

禮拜 s1 o6: (祖堂集), (雲居) section; the discipleship bow — the army commissioner first refuses to bow and sits facing him (統軍使不禮拜而對坐), asks "when will the world find peace?" (世界什摩時得安), is answered "when the general's heart is satisfied" (待將軍心足), and "the commander thereupon bowed and took him as teacher" (統軍便禮拜為師). The bow that seals a teacher-student bond (also 州主便禮拜為師, "the prefect thereupon bowed and took him as teacher," in the Huangbo [黃蘗] chapter, lb 0609b09). Narrated → MasterName null.

禮拜 s1 o7: In the Collection from the Patriarchs' Hall, the emperor “thereupon bowed” (便禮拜) and then asked another question. This anchors ruler and ceremonial deployment without changing the bodily-action sense.

禮拜 s1 o7 expected '祖堂集': In the Collection from the Patriarchs' Hall, the emperor “thereupon bowed” (便禮拜) and then asked another question. This anchors ruler and ceremonial deployment without changing the bodily-action sense.

禮拜 s1 o8: The monk “bowed and returned to the assembly” (禮拜歸眾), after which the master continued, “the magpie chatters before the eaves” (喜鵲簷前噪). This anchors the bow within public-interview choreography.

禮拜 s1 o8 expected '憨休禪師語錄': The monk “bowed and returned to the assembly” (禮拜歸眾), after which the master continued, “the magpie chatters before the eaves” (喜鵲簷前噪). This anchors the bow within public-interview choreography.
禮拜 s1 o9: The participant “bowed, rose, and took up one of his sandals” (禮拜起來，收他一隻履). The passage makes the bow-and-rise bodily sequence explicit.
